decision: No further investigation necessary; no penalty will be imposed.
event_name: Date 27 September 2020 Time 11:55 2020 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 September 2020 The Stewards Title Decision - Racing Point rear brake ducts Description Decision - Racing Point rear brake ducts
fact: Rear brake ducts of car 18 and car 11
offence: Breach of Articles 2.1 and 3.2. of the FIA F1 Sporting Regulations.
penalty: No further investigation necessary; no penalty will be imposed.
reason: BWT Racing Point F1 Team submitted to the Stewards a confirmation that the rear brake ducts used in the 2020 Russian Grand Prix are of the same specification as those run by the team in the previous F1 events since 2020 Styrian Grand Prix. With reference to the Steward's Protest Decisions of 07 August 2020 and the Steward's decision according to Doc. 47 of the Tuscan Grand Prix 2020, the content of which is hereby fully complied with, the Stewards see no reason to request further reports or to initiate any investigations into the brake ducts mentioned.
stewards: having received a document from BWT Racing Point F1 Team
determine the following: No / Driver 18 – Lance Stroll
11 – Sergio Perez Competitor BWT Racing Point F1 Team
title: Decision Racing Point Rear Brake Ducts
